arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/dev/t1.py <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from harness import *

# ---------- BAD_HEADER variants ----------
tr = trace([datagram(bytes([0xc4,0,0,0,1,1,0xaa,1,0xbb,0x00,0x02,0x00,0x01]),[0])])  # reserved bits set
t=one(tr); check('badhdr-reserved', (status(t), t['datagrams'][0]['accepted'], t['datagrams'][0]['bytes']), ('BAD_HEADER',0,0))
check('badhdr-nulls', (t['packets'][0]['level'],t['packets'][0]['pn'],t['packets'][0]['epoch'],t['packets'][0]['sha256']), (None,None,None,None))

# wrong version
tr = trace([datagram(bytes([0xc0,0,0,0,2,1,0xaa,1,0xbb,0x00,0x02,0x00,0x01]),[0])])
t=one(tr); check('badhdr-version', status(t), 'BAD_HEADER')

# version truncated
tr = trace([datagram(bytes([0xc0,0,0,1]),[0])])
t=one(tr); check('badhdr-version-trunc', status(t), 'BAD_HEADER')

# dcid length 21
tr = trace([datagram(bytes([0xc0,0,0,0,1,21]+[0]*21+[1,0xbb,0x00,0x02,0x00,0x01]),[0])])
t=one(tr); check('badhdr-dcilong', status(t), 'BAD_HEADER')

# length beyond datagram
tr = trace([datagram(bytes([0xc0,0,0,0,1,1,0xaa,1,0xbb,0x00,0x50,0x00,0x01]),[0])])
t=one(tr); check('badhdr-length', status(t), 'BAD_HEADER')

# length < pn width
tr = trace([datagram(bytes([0xc3,0,0,0,1,1,0xaa,1,0xbb,0x00,0x02,0x00]),[0])])
t=one(tr); check('badhdr-length-lt-pn', status(t), 'BAD_HEADER')

# 0-dcid long header, routing fails -> DROP_CID
tr = trace([datagram(bytes([0xc0,0,0,0,1,0,0,0x00,0x02,0x00,0x01]),[0])])
t=one(tr); check('long-zerodcid-dropcid', (status(t),t['packets'][0]['pn']), ('DROP_CID',0))

# short header bad flags: 0x00
tr = trace([datagram(bytes([0x00]),[0])])
t=one(tr); check('short-badflags', status(t), 'BAD_HEADER')
# short header fixed bit missing 0x80 set -> long attempt path: 0x80 with garbage version -> BAD
tr = trace([datagram(bytes([0x80,0,0,0,1,1,0xaa,1,0xbb,0x00,0x02,0x00,0x01]),[0])])
t=one(tr); check('longtype-0rtt-ish', status(t), 'BAD_HEADER')
# 0xd0 = long type 1 (0-RTT)
tr = trace([datagram(bytes([0xd0,0,0,0,1,1,0xaa,1,0xbb,0x00,0x02,0x00,0x01]),[0])])
t=one(tr); check('longtype-0rtt', status(t), 'BAD_HEADER')

# empty datagram
tr = trace([datagram(b'',[])])
t=one(tr)
check('empty-datagram', (t['datagrams'][0]['packets'],t['datagrams'][0]['accepted'],t['datagrams'][0]['bytes'],t['datagrams'][0]['sha256']), (0,0,0,sha(b'')))

# ---------- key / auth ----------
# A packet without A keys -> NO_KEY
tr = trace([datagram(bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x00,0x01]),[0])])
t=one(tr); check('no-key', (status(t),t['packets'][0]['epoch']), ('NO_KEY',None))
# with A keys, annotation 0 -> OK
tr = trace([{'keys':['A']}, datagram(bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x00,0x01]),[0])])
t=one(tr); check('a-ok', (status(t),t['packets'][0]['epoch'],t['keys']), ('OK',0,['A']))
# null annotation -> AUTH
tr = trace([{'keys':['A']}, datagram(bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x00,0x01]),[None])])
t=one(tr); check('a-null-auth', (status(t),t['packets'][0]['epoch']), ('AUTH',None))
# annotation out of window (2) -> AUTH
tr = trace([{'keys':['A']}, datagram(bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x00,0x01]),[2])])
t=one(tr); check('a-window', (status(t),t['packets'][0]['epoch']), ('AUTH',None))
# wrong parity: annotation 1 (odd) phase 0
tr = trace([{'keys':['A']}, datagram(bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x00,0x01]),[1])])
t=one(tr); check('a-parity', (status(t),t['packets'][0]['epoch']), ('AUTH',None))
# phase 1 header first byte 0x44, annotation 1 -> OK
tr = trace([{'keys':['A']}, datagram(bytes([0x44,0xaa,0x00,0x01]),[1])])
t=one(tr); check('a-phase1', (status(t),t['packets'][0]['epoch']), ('OK',1))
# I packet with annotation 1 -> AUTH
tr = trace([datagram(bytes([0xc0,0,0,0,1,1,0xaa,1,0xbb,0,2,0,1]),[1])])
t=one(tr); check('i-ann1', (status(t),t['packets'][0]['epoch']), ('AUTH',None))
# missing annotation entry -> AUTH
tr = trace([datagram(bytes([0xc0,0,0,0,1,1,0xaa,1,0xbb,0,2,0,1]),[])])
t=one(tr); check('i-ann-missing', status(t), 'AUTH')
# extra annotations ignored
tr = trace([datagram(bytes([0xc0,0,0,0,1,1,0xaa,1,0xbb,0,2,0,1]),[0,None,7])])
t=one(tr); check('i-ann-extra', status(t), 'OK')

# ---------- duplicate ----------
p1 = bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x00,0x01])
tr = trace([{'keys':['A']}, datagram(p1,[0]), datagram(p1,[0])])
t=one(tr)
check('dup', (t['packets'][0]['status'],t['packets'][1]['status'],t['packets'][1]['epoch'],t['packets'][1]['sha256'],t['received']['A']), ('OK','DUPLICATE',0,None,0))
# duplicate after auth failure is AUTH (auth precedes duplicate)
tr = trace([{'keys':['A']}, datagram(p1,[0]), datagram(p1,[None])])
t=one(tr); check('dup-auth-first', t['packets'][1]['status'], 'AUTH')
# non-duplicate lower pn is OK (no ordering rule within level)
tr = trace([{'keys':['A']},
            datagram(bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x05,0x01]),[0]),
            datagram(bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x02,0x01]),[0])])
t=one(tr)
check('reorder', (t['packets'][0]['status'],t['packets'][1]['status'],t['received']['A']), ('OK','OK',5))
# duplicate of seed
tr = trace([{'keys':['A']}], received={'A':7})
tr['events'].append(datagram(bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x07,0x01]),[0]))
t=one(tr); check('dup-seed', (t['packets'][0]['status'],t['received']['A']), ('DUPLICATE',7))

# ---------- PN reconstruction ----------
# expected 0, raw 0x00 width1 -> 0
tr = trace([{'keys':['A']}, datagram(bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x00,0x01]),[0])])
t=one(tr); check('pn0', t['packets'][0]['pn'], 0)
# expected 1 (after pn 0 accepted), raw 0x02 -> 2
tr = trace([{'keys':['A']}, datagram(bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x00,0x01]),[0]), datagram(bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x02,0x01]),[0])])
t=one(tr); check('pn2', t['packets'][1]['pn'], 2)
# tie: expected 32768 width2 raw0 -> 65536
tr = trace([{'keys':['A']}], received={'A':32767})
tr['events'].append(datagram(bytes([0x41,0xaa,0x00,0x00,0x01]),[0]))
t=one(tr); check('pn-tie', t['packets'][0]['pn'], 65536)
# seed 32767 -> expected 32768; raw 0x0000 width 2 -> closest: 0 (d=32768) vs 65536 (d=32768) tie -> 65536
# raw 0xffff width 2 = 65535 -> candidates 65535 (d=32767) -> 65535
tr = trace([{'keys':['A']}], received={'A':32767})
tr['events'].append(datagram(bytes([0x41,0xaa,0xff,0xff,0x01]),[0]))
t=one(tr); check('pn-near', t['packets'][0]['pn'], 65535)
# width-1 raw 0x80=128 with expected 0 -> candidates 128 (d=128) vs -128 invalid -> 128
tr = trace([{'keys':['A']}, datagram(bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x80,0x01]),[0])])
t=one(tr); check('pn-128', t['packets'][0]['pn'], 128)

print('failures:',len(FAILURES))
EOF
